Settings

Database Upload

Master database. "All depots" deletes the old database completely and restarts the app on the new one. To fix only some data, choose "Only the depots in the file" or "Only the customers in the file": just those are replaced and everything else stays as it is.

Daily Collection & Order

Daily “Collection and Order-year” file. The last sheet’s last date is used (always the previous day).

DCR (Daily Call Report)

Your DCR Excel file. Every visit in it is added to your DCR entries (a visit already entered in the app is not added again), so the Admin can see it too.
